[SWS_PHM_00226]
{DRAFT}
Keep Global Supervision Status
kFAILED
⌈
If
the
Global Supervision Status
is
kFAILED
, the
Elementary Supervision
Status
of at least one Alive, Deadline or Logical Supervision is
kFAILED
and no su-
pervision is in
Elementary Supervision Status kEXPIRED
, then the
Platform
Health Management
shall keep the
Global Supervision Status kFAILED
.
⌋
(RS_PHM_00111)
